groups.activity: reach Neptune Proxima or join a host

rows.label: one Intrinsic at rank 3
rows.alt: only the host needs it in a pre-formed squad

rows.label: free Companion slots
rows.note: one for Nautilus and one for its bundled Verglas

conditions: Neptune Proxima normally requires clearing Saturn Proxima first. A host can bring you in early.
Piloting Intrinsic rank 5 puts a white waypoint on the abandoned derelict and makes the farm substantially easier.
Verglas has no separate blueprint, Market listing, drop table, or Foundry recipe. It is delivered fully assembled when Nautilus is claimed.
bonuses: Buying Nautilus built from the in-game Market includes both inventory slots and skips this entire farm.

groups.activity: find the Ice Mine derelict, then hack its cache before finishing
conditions: The abandoned derelict is an optional point of interest with its own reward table; it does not spawn every run. If it is absent, restart rather than finish a no-roll mission.
Do the derelict before the main objective. A public squad can extract while you are still inside it.
Arva Vector Defense is the slower backup: its rotation B and C rates are 4.65% and 4.26% per part.
All four Nautilus parts trade, but Verglas itself does not. Stop farming and buy the final missing part rather than chasing duplicates.
bonuses: Run a Neptune Void Storm when available: its Nautilus rolls are unchanged and relic drops can become Platinum for a missing part.

disclosures.title: the weapon farm is really a sentinel farm
disclosures.body: Every Verglas route ends by acquiring Nautilus. The Ice Mine's cache has the best per-part odds, but all four items share a roughly 6% roll with duplicates and no pity system; expect a long RNG farm. The practical exit is to trade for missing Nautilus pieces, or compare that cost against the 75 platinum built Nautilus Market purchase, which also provides the slots and bundled weapon.

groups.activity: build Nautilus and claim Verglas with it

rows.label: Nullstones
rows.note: picked up in Neptune or Pluto Proxima

conditions: The normal Nautilus build takes 24 hours; claim it only after confirming both Companion slots are open.
bonuses: Verglas arrives free and fully built with Nautilus—there is no second build timer or weapon recipe.

disclosures.title: Verglas Prime is a different bundle
disclosures.body: Verglas Prime only comes with Nautilus Prime. Its relics are currently vaulted, so trade for Nautilus Prime parts or vaulted relics, or check Varzia's current Prime Resurgence stock. Do not buy a base Verglas separately: neither version is sold as an independent weapon.
